notes: Fixed a critical Windows issue where the 'Log in to Claude' button wouldn't open a browser on first launch — you can now sign in right away.
Much faster remote (mobile) access — we compressed screen assets to greatly cut loading time.

Many stability fixes — agents that sometimes didn't show up or went missing when created in bulk, conversation cards stuck on 'Loading…', and already-finished cards wrongly marked as failed after a server restart.
Your card now shows, in color, how heavy the conversation has grown — the more it builds up, the redder it gets, so you know when to start a fresh chat.
You can now delete task categories with an ✕, and we fixed the Arena weekly ranking order.
